findings.claim: When source generation is suppressed, a member carrying an attribute derived from KeyAttribute is skipped before its member type is collected. Consequently, a referenced type that lacks [MessagePackObject] no longer receives MsgPack003 (and any later member-specific checks are likewise bypassed), contrary to the requirement that analyzer diagnostics continue to work with suppression enabled. The same early continue was added to both the field and property paths.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the generated DerivedKeySuppressionReceiptTests.DerivedKeyDoesNotSuppressMemberTypeDiagnostics test. With build_property.SuppressSourceGeneration=true, a [MessagePackObject] container has a [CustomKey] property whose type is not annotated; the generator run should contain MsgPack003, but the new continue at TypeCollector.cs:1083 prevents member-type collection so the assertion fails. The equivalent field case is skipped at line 921.
